page.overview:
What is Thermal flechette?

Thermal flechettes were weapons used by the hunters Winloss and Nokk. When encountering the reanimated body of Tam Posla while hunting down Doctor Chelli Aphra on Milvayne, Winloss suggested using thermal flechettes against him. Nokk disagreed, using a Vr'gedian tranquilizer harpoon to impale Posla.
